name: outlook-mcp
description: Read, draft, and send Outlook email, manage your calendar and contacts, and use Teams chats from your work or school Microsoft 365 account.
long_description: Connects your AI app to your own Microsoft 365 mailbox through Microsoft Graph, using an app registration you create yourself. The first time you use it, it shows a Microsoft sign-in link and code. Step-by-step guide: https://github.com/gchallen/outlook-mcp/blob/main/docs/GUIDED-SETUP.md

email.title: Work or school email address
email.description: The Microsoft 365 account to connect, e.g. you@university.edu

client_id.title: Application (client) ID
client_id.description: From the Overview page of the app you registered at entra.microsoft.com

signature.title: Email signature (optional)
signature.description: Added to the end of every email. Type \n for a line break. You can also ask Claude to set it later.

teams.title: Include Microsoft Teams
teams.description: Turn off if sign-in says your organization needs an administrator to approve Teams access
